SELECT 
    rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
    ps.safety_metrics ->> 'safety_state' AS safety_incident_score,
    mf.faultpredscore AS recent_fault_prediction_score,
FROM 
    robot_details AS rd
JOIN 
    performance_and_safety AS ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
JOIN 
    maintenance_and_fault AS mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
ORDER BY 
    ps.safety_metrics ->> 'safety_state' DESC, 
    mf.faultpredscore DESC
LIMIT 10;
